item.title: How Palisades High reopened: inside the public/private effort that brought students back to campus
item.description: Palisades Charter High School has reopened with 36 modular classrooms following wildfire damage. The complex recovery effort involved LAUSD, Santa Monica officials, and private sector partners to bring students back to campus after months of displacement.

item.title: New poll supporting continued airport operations flies in the face of conventional wisdom
item.description: A new poll from Santa Monica shows 67% of voters support keeping the city's airport open in some capacity, challenging the city's plans to close the facility in 2028 and convert it to parkland. Only 25% favor complete closure.

item.title: HexClad and LA’s Culinary Leaders support Steadfast LA in Wildfire Recovery Efforts
item.description: HexClad hosted 'Rise & Dine LA' at Riviera Country Club in Pacific Palisades, bringing together Gordon Ramsay, Dominique Crenn, and other culinary stars to support Steadfast LA's wildfire recovery efforts. The event featured 300 guests including Dr. Dre and a performance by Macy Gray.

item.title: Library Selects Japanese Novel for Annual Citywide Reading Program
item.description: The Santa Monica Public Library selected 'What You Are Looking For Is in the Library' for its 2026 Santa Monica Reads program. The 23rd annual community-wide reading initiative will run Feb. 2 through March 14, featuring author Michiko Aoyama for discussion and signing events.

item.title: Santa Monica College Plans Valentine's Glass Sale
item.description: Santa Monica College will hold a Valentine's Glass Sale on Saturday, Feb. 7 from 8am-2pm at Virginia Avenue Park. The fundraiser will feature handcrafted hearts, jewelry, vases and other artworks created by SMC glass artists to benefit the college's Art Department.

item.title: British Vocal Ensemble to Perform 'Queen of Hearts' Concert at St. Matthew's Church
item.description: The Gesualdo Six, an acclaimed British vocal ensemble, will perform Renaissance music from influential European queens at St. Matthew's Church in Pacific Palisades on February 6, 2026, marking the venue's first concert since the 2025 fires.

item.title: It ‘took a village’ to heal her trauma and homelessness. Will California keep funding this help?
item.description: A Los Angeles woman shares how the Downtown Women's Center Trauma Recovery Center helped her overcome decades of trauma and homelessness. Now, Proposition 36 threatens funding for these vital programs across California.

item.title: Local Businesses Honored at Green Business Certification Awards
item.description: Several Santa Monica businesses earned recognition for their environmental leadership at the Green Business Certification Awards held January 16th at the Santa Monica Family YMCA, celebrating their commitment to sustainable practices and rigorous environmental standards.
